title: sign_article must NOT add nonce — CID idempotency requires deterministic signing
description: reader/src/post/sign.rs:73-74: the comment 'Do NOT add a nonce or timestamp to the signature; that would break CID idempotency and cause duplicate articles in IPFS' captures a non-obvious invariant. Ed25519 via ed25519-dalek uses RFC 8032 deterministic signing: same key + same bytes → same signature → same CID. A future contributor might see 'deterministic Ed25519' and think 'security concern, we should add per-signature randomness' (as in Ed25519ph or with a random nonce). That change would make every sign_article call produce a different CID even for the same article, making the msgid_map→CID mapping ambiguous and causing duplicates in IPFS on retry. The no-nonce constraint must stay and the comment is load-bearing documentation.
